_doc: Ratchet allowances for the plugin-kernel migration guardrails.
A guardrail fails when the current violation count EXCEEDS its allowance.
Allowances may only be lowered, never raised. Target for every key is 0.
Numbers recorded at P0 (baseline-1.7.0) unless noted. See docs/migration/.
The `ui` block is the same mechanism applied to the front-end design system;
its guardrail is G20 (tests/guardrails/ui-design-system.test.ts) and its
measurements come from scripts/migration/ui-audit.mjs. See docs/design-system.md.
_shimPages_note: One-line forwarding shims in a plugin-owned tree ('fake pluginization'). P5.2 reached the target: all 61 page shims became the real implementations, and 1 misfiled duplicate shim was deleted because no route imported it. src/pages/Student is now empty and src/pages/Teacher holds only the 5 pages that never had a shim.
_deadCode_note: Application-unreachable files. P4.3b.6 lowered this 65 -> 64 by deleting api/modules/pet (10 files, of which 1 was counted): its 17 routes moved into plugins/pet, so the module became unreachable rather than merely unused. Workspace cleanup lowered 64 -> 58 by deleting 6 genuinely-orphaned entries from this list (src/hooks/useTheme.ts, src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx, src/features/admin/api/adminAdapters.ts, src/features/admin/hooks/useAdminCms.ts, src/features/engagement/hooks/useCertificates.ts, src/hooks/queries/useTeacherPets.ts) plus one unlisted shim; ErrorBoundary's planned P5 revival is cancelled, so it must be re-added deliberately if ever remounted. P4.3b.6b deleted api/modules/classroom and api/modules/learning (8 files) and the three shared services they were the last consumers of (api/services/pointsService.ts, studentService.ts, featureService.ts - the point helpers now live in plugins/classroom, the 19 legacy enable_* gates in the capability system): the count moves 58 -> 69 -> 61 -> 58 as each layer stops being imported, and lands back on the same ceiling. featureService.ts was P7's stated target; it turned out to be unreachable the moment its last importer left, which is the right time to delete it. P4.3b.10 raised it 58 -> 59: migrating the engagement domain left `src/features/engagement/api/praisesApi.ts` with no importer (its only consumer was a hook deleted in the earlier workspace cleanup), so the frontend api module joined the list. That is the same shape as the previous round's finding - a domain migration can raise this number when it removes the last reference to a file nothing else used - and the honest response is to record the file rather than delete it on the way past, because it is P7's cleanup list, not this migration's. P4.3b.14 LOWERED it 59 -> 55 by deleting the files whose last consumer was the module this round removed. `api/modules/admin` was the final importer of `api/utils/apiError.ts`, `apiResponse.ts`, `classFeatures.ts`, `gameErrors.ts`, `password.ts`, `requestAuth.ts`, `response.ts` and `api/services/UserService.ts` (its own test with it), so those nine files went in the same commit - the same rule P4.3b.6b followed for pointsService/studentService/featureService. `api/prismaClient.ts` remains on the list: `plugins/admin` was the last *runtime* consumer of Prisma (P4.3b.9's two-data-paths guardrail, tests/kernel/database-path-alignment.test.ts, is the only importer left), and removing the client itself belongs to P7 together with `prisma/schema.prisma`'s other consumers.
_staticPluginRoutes_note: Static plugin-owned imports in the route entry file. P5.2b reached the target: AppRoutes.tsx is now a renderer over src/app/routing/routeTable.ts, and page modules are looked up in a map generated from that table, so the route layer never names a plugin module. Target reached - this must stay 0.
_legacyFeatureKeySurfaces_note: Files that hardcode a list of the legacy class feature keys. P4 removed the backend copy by deriving the names from the class row and moving the catalogue into the classroom plugin manifest. P5 removed the frontend copy the same way: src/lib/classFeatures.generated.ts is generated from plugins/classroom/plugin.json by `npm run class-features`, and G13 verifies it is up to date. Target reached - this must stay 0.
_adoptedTables_note: P3: plugins that own a table still carrying its legacy name (see PluginDataDeclaration.adopted). Grown by design across P4.3b as domains migrate: classroom 2, economy 3, dungeon 1, gacha 3, slg 2, battles 1, challenge 2, collaboration 5, marketplace 4, portal 3 = 26; P4.3b.5 added system 2 (question_bank, system_settings) = 28; P4.3b.5b added assignments 4 (assignments, student_assignments, exams, student_exams) = 32; P4.3b.5d added parent-buff 1 (parent_activity) = 33; P4.3b.6 added pet 1 (`pets`) = 34. The pet entry is the one increment that did NOT add a new table to the system: `pets` was already the domain's storage, and the P3 reference table it replaced (`p_pet_pets`) was invented and empty. Every entry is renamed to p_<slug>_ by P7 (target 0). Permanently-shared tables (currently `records`) are EXCLUDED and checked separately, as is the one shared-WRITE table (`redemption_tickets`) - see the SHARED_WRITE_TABLES set in plugin-manifest-conformance.test.ts. The ratchet's real guard is that this cannot grow except by migrating another domain, so every increment is enumerated here by hand. P4.3b.6b added learning 16 = 50: knowledge_edges, knowledge_nodes, paper_answers, paper_assets, paper_items, paper_sections, paper_submissions, papers, question_knowledge, questions, rubric_points, study_plan_items, study_plans, subjects, wrong_question_attempts, wrong_questions. That set is exactly the tables the migrated code reads or writes, measured against the deleted api/modules/learning service rather than guessed; the sibling tables in the same schema cluster (rubric_point_scores, knowledge_products, notes, note_assets, note_products) are deliberately NOT claimed because no route in the plugin touches them - claiming them would inflate this ratchet and misstate ownership. P4.3b.7 added identity 3 = 53: users, activation_codes, activation_events. These are the first entries that make an *existing, previously unowned* table owned - the boot schema created them and api/modules/auth wrote them through Prisma, so before this the ownership check had nothing to check on them, and api/modules/admin still writes them that way. P4.3b.8 added payment 2 = 55: payment_orders, payment_transactions - the two tables that had no table at all until P4.3b.5c created them from prisma/schema.prisma, which is why every /api/payment route answered 500 on a boot-schema database before that. With them, every table the payment routes touch has an owner. P4.3b.10 added engagement 10 = 65: announcements, certificates, class_announcements, danmaku_messages, family_tasks, lucky_draw_config, messages, praises, redemption_tickets, user_achievements. The last two are the two HANDOFF section 8.9 called ownership problems: `redemption_tickets` is the documented SHARED_WRITE_TABLES exception (marketplace issues tickets too, and that is named in the manifest rather than hidden), and `user_achievements` is the store behind the message feed's `sender_title`, claimed by nobody else. This is the last increment from a domain migration: admin and insights own no tables of their own that a plugin could adopt under a new name. P4.3b.14 moved it 65 -> 74 for a different reason, and that difference is worth stating: the round's ruling (docs/migration/admin-cascade-decision.md) is that the 58-table account-deletion cascade becomes per-plugin cleanup rules, and a rule may only delete from tables its plugin declared - so seven tables that the pre-migration cascade deleted but NOBODY owned had to get an owner first. classroom +5 = 70: attendance_records, leave_requests, parent_students, student_groups, point_presets - all five already read by classroom and already written by it through ctx.rawDb, which its manifest recorded as debt precisely because there was no owner to publish a port. learning +2 = 72: notes and rubric_point_scores, the same schema cluster as rubric_points (which rubric_point_scores also references). plugins/admin +3 = 75: api_keys and schools (boot-schema tables whose only reader and writer in the repository was this console), plus `announcements`, which MOVED from engagement - and engagement -1 = 74, because it only runs `SELECT * FROM announcements WHERE is_active = 1` for its feed route while the console is the table's only writer. This is the same shape as identity's P4.3b.7 increment - giving an existing, previously unowned table its first owner - not a new domain adopting new storage.
_routeCollisions_note: METHOD+PATH pairs served by more than one controller file. Invisible to the surface snapshot because it compares sets, and only the first registration is reachable. Peaked at 33 mid-migration (every plugin whose legacy module still existed), fell to 1 in P5.3b, and reached the target in P4.3b.6: the last one was plugins/pet vs api/modules/pet on GET /api/pet/students/:studentId, which could not be fixed by deleting the module because the plugin was not an equivalent replacement (4 endpoints, invented tables). P4.3b.6 ported all 17 legacy routes onto the real `pets` table and deleted the module. P4.3b.6b repeated the exercise for two more domains at once (classroom 47 pairs, learning 24, peak 71 while both legacy modules were still registered) and returned to 0 by deleting api/modules/classroom and api/modules/learning. This must stay 0 - a new collision means a domain is registered in both places again, and the way to fix it is deleting the legacy module, never raising this number.

_doc: Front-end design-system debt, measured by `node scripts/migration/ui-audit.mjs` at the
UI-refactor baseline (P0). Unlike the migration keys these do not all start at 0: the
baseline is the debt the refactor exists to remove, so each key is recorded at its
measured value and may only fall. Phase targets are in docs/design-system.md.
Every key counts OCCURRENCES and reports `path:line`, because a failure that only says
`263` cannot be acted on. Test files are excluded by rule; hex colours in
src/lib/brandIcon.ts (the single definition of the brand mark) and
src/lib/celebrationPalette.ts (the confetti palette) are exempt by name, not by path.
ui._rawButtons_note: Raw <button> elements outside the component layer. The baseline was 263 against 11 imports of the shared Button. P2 262, P3 253, P4 209, P5 191, P6 48, P7 1: the whole app is on the kit. The one left is deliberate and documented - the big screen's 3xl countdown readout on a projection stage, which the kit's 2.25rem control cannot carry; it has an aria-label.
ui._rawInputs_note: Raw <input> elements outside the component layer. 96 at the baseline, 0 now: every field in the app is the kit's Input/Checkbox/FileInput inside a FormField.
ui._rawSelects_note: Raw <select> elements outside the component layer. 27 at the baseline, 0 now - the kit's Select is a styled native element on purpose, so no page writes one.
ui._rawTables_note: Raw <table> elements outside the component layer. 13 at the baseline, 0 now: every table is DataTable, which also absorbed the fourteen hand-written loading rows and empty blocks that came with them.
ui._hexColors_note: Hex colour literals in src/**/*.ts(x). 67 at the baseline (16 of them loginStyles.ts, a second copy of the role palettes, deleted in P3; 25 of them confetti arrays, moved into src/lib/celebrationPalette.ts in P7). 0 now, with the brand mark and the celebration palettes exempt by name.
ui._offBrandAccents_note: Accent utilities from colour families the product does not use: indigo, violet, purple, fuchsia, pink, rose. 790 at the first measurement - portal 120, student 167, teacher 205, admin 31, parent 19 - and 0 now, page family by page family: P3 portal, P4 admin, P5 parent, P6 teacher, P7 student. This is the key that made "one accent palette" a measurement rather than an intention.
ui._inlineStyles_note: React `style={{ }}` props. 18 at the baseline, 3 now, and all three are values that cannot be a class: the danmaku overlay positions each message by its own percentage and colour (server data), and two bar widths are animation-driven. Every ordinary width bar is the kit's Progress, whose fill is Base UI's.
ui._nativeDialogs_note: Blocking `confirm()` / `prompt()` / `window.alert()` calls. 14 at the baseline (19 after P4 widened the metric to see `window.confirm(`), 0 now: every confirmation is a ConfirmDialog, and each old sentence survives verbatim as the dialog's description.
ui._importantOverrides_note: `!important` occurrences in src/index.css. 14 at the baseline: the radius and shadow flattening, the portal's force-recolour block (nine rules repainting indigo/violet green) and the admin repaint block (four making the console's dark panels white). P3 deleted the first, P4 the second, P8 the third - after rewriting its dependents to the tokens it was forcing them to. A new override block now fails G20 instead of being reviewed.
ui._recolorRules_note: Rule blocks in src/index.css whose selector targets `.public-campus-page` to repaint indigo/violet classes green. P3 reached the target: the public pages use the tokens themselves, so the block was deleted.
ui._inertTokens_note: Tailwind v4-only constructs in source that Tailwind 3.4.19 cannot compile, so they are inert wherever they are written. P1 took this to 0: `ring-3` -> `ring-[3px]`, `not-aria-[...]` -> an arbitrary variant, `has-data-[...]` -> `has-[[data-...]]`, `in-data-[...]` -> `[[data-slot=...]_&]`, `*:[img:...]` -> `[&>img:...]`, `[.border-b]` -> `[&.border-b]`, `@container/card-header` deleted (no container-query variant exists), `data-open:`/`data-closed:`/`data-inset:`/`data-disabled:` -> the bracketed v3 form, `max-h-(--x)` -> `max-h-[var(--x)]`, `supports-backdrop-filter:` -> `supports-[backdrop-filter]:`, `rounded-4xl` -> `rounded-pill`, `size-3!` -> `!size-3`, `outline-hidden` -> `outline-none`, and the `tw-animate-css` composition (`animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2`) -> single v3 animations defined in tailwind.config.js. The metric was also corrected twice along the way: the named form `group-data-[size=sm]/card` compiles in v3.4 (79 -> 74), and both `!important` and these patterns used to be counted inside comments, so writing down a defect scored as adding one. Whatever the count is, G20 compiles each listed construct and asserts it is still inert - so this number cannot be lowered by relabelling working code.
ui._unresolvedTokenUtilities_note: Colour utilities that name a token the stylesheet declares but `theme.extend.colors` never registers. P1 registered card/card-foreground/popover/popover-foreground/sidebar*/chart*/canvas/paper/ink/status: `bg-card` and `text-card-foreground` now compile and the kit's Card renders a background.
ui._deadUtilities_note: Utilities declared in `@layer utilities` of src/index.css that no source file uses. P1 deleted all six (gemini-gradient, gemini-gradient-text, soft-shadow, glow-shadow, campus-panel, campus-soft-panel): they were the third copy of the same look - tokens, these utilities, and the override blocks - and nothing referenced them.
ui._unresolvedCssImports_note: `@import` specifiers in src/index.css that resolve to nothing. P1 removed `@import "shadcn/tailwind.css"`: node_modules/shadcn/tailwind.css does not exist, so the line had never contributed anything.
ui._v4OnlyCssImports_note: `@import` specifiers that are Tailwind-v4-only packages. P1 removed `tw-animate-css`; the animations the pages actually write (`animate-slide-in-top` and friends) are now real keyframes in tailwind.config.js, so 24 class usages that had never animated anything now play.

_p7p8_note: P7 (the student area) and P8 (cleanup) closed the last of the debt this file measures.
Every page-level metric is at its target; the three that are not zero are named
exceptions rather than debt: one projection-stage button, three inline styles that
carry data or animation values, and nothing else. See docs/design-system.md.
